Meta.tagline: Coming soon. A marketplace built for Romania.
Meta.description: A new place to discover, connect, and transact with people you can trust.

Landing.title: Find good people, when you need them.
Landing.subtitle: A calm, considered place to discover specialists near you, see how they work, and book without friction. Join the waitlist and you'll be the first to know when we launch.
Landing.waitlistSuccess: Thanks — we'll let you know when we launch.
Landing.waitlistNote: No spam. One notification at launch.
Landing.pillar1Body: People and places you'd recommend onward.
Landing.pillar2Body: Portfolio, reviews, what makes them theirs — before you take the first step.
Landing.pillar3Body: One place for appointments. No threads scattered across four apps.
